# Best noise-cancelling headphones under $100

**Top pick: Soundcore Space One (~$100, about $80 with a code)**
- Best Products named it the best overall under $100. It has adaptive ANC, a good companion app, rotating ear cups and a 55-hour battery (40 hours with ANC on) ([Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/)).
- Dealectric reports that code **AFSC20** took $19.99 off the $99.99 price at Soundcore's US store when tested on 2026-10-22, which makes it about $80. The code expires 2026-12-31 and doesn't apply to items already on sale, and checkout has the final word. [Buy at Soundcore](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-space-one) (affiliate link, so the site earns a commission at no cost to you).
- Downsides: no sweat resistance, so they're not for workouts, and they're heavier than some rivals. LDAC doesn't work while connected to two devices ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/soundcore-space-one)).

**Best noise isolation: Soundcore Space Q45 (~$100)**
RTINGS found it the best budget ANC headphone it tested, with excellent noise isolation against engine rumble and chatter. It has a shorter battery, about 28 hours, and some owners report the headband cracking ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)).

**Best cheaper alternatives**
- **Soundcore Life Q20 (2024):** nearly matches the Q45's noise isolation for less money and has a 49-hour battery. The build is plasticky and the pads can flake ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)).
- **Soundcore Life Q30:** RTINGS' top over-ear under $100, with about 44 hours of battery and good ANC, though it leaks sound ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/over-ear-headphones-under-100)).
- **Edifier Atom Max (~$45):** strong value, with hybrid ANC and a 45-hour battery ([Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/)).
- **1MORE SonoFlow (~$65):** TechRadar's pick under $100 is the SonoFlow Pro HQ51 ([TechRadar](https://www.techradar.com/audio/headphones/best-noise-cancelling-headphones)). CartIQ lists the cheaper SonoFlow SE, which has a 70-hour battery but weaker ANC ([CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/)).

**Other options**
- **Sony WH-CH720N (~$99):** very light at 192 g, but supports only SBC and AAC ([CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/)).
- **JBL Tune 760NC:** bass-heavy with a good mic, but RTINGS found its ANC mediocre ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/over-ear-headphones-under-100)).
- **Raycon The Everyday (~$80):** IPX4 sweat resistance for workouts, but the battery is shorter than claimed ([Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/)).

**Bottom line:** Get the Space One for the best all-round value, especially at about $80 with the code. Choose the Q45 if noise blocking matters most, or the Edifier Atom Max if you want to spend as little as possible. Prices change often, so check the final price at checkout.
